author: Seung Wook
problem: Ten points numbered 1 to 10 are placed around a circle in order, so 10 is next to 1. Read a and b (1 <= a < b <= 10) and print Yes if they are directly connected neighbours, otherwise No.
bug_description: The first condition is just 'b - a' (always truthy since a < b) instead of 'b - a == 1', so every pair prints Yes.

comments.accurate: Prints Yes when a and b are adjacent around the 10-point circle
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints Yes whenever b differs from a, or when the pair wraps around from 10 to 1
comments.wrong_location: Adjacency condition verified; check that a and b are parsed as integers

source.buggy_line: if b - a or b - a == 9:
source.fixed_line: if b - a == 1 or b - a == 9:
